subject: strict-orphan-scanner misses hand-authored hub pages (32 false orphans)
description:
The canonical CySA+ course page _app/houses/eye/cysa/index.html presents all 32 eye-cysa chapter modules (verified: it links every one of their files), but the scanner cannot see it: the page is hand-authored HTML that never matches HUB_SIGNATURE_RE, and its data-module values are abbreviated (ch01..ch16) rather than full catalog ids. Before the cysa path retirement those 32 were rescued by mechanism2 (LearningPaths); now they report as orphans. They are NOT orphans. Fix direction: add a reachability mechanism that maps a hub page's linked FILE PATHS to catalog ids, which would cover every hand-authored course page, not just this one. Logged 2026-07-28 during BUG-038; delta measured 727 -> 768.
[2026-07-29 03:28] SCOPE EVIDENCE 2026-07-28: measured corpus-wide, link-resolution rescues 205 of 768 orphans (768 -> 563). 204 of the 205 are linked by a page in the SAME house as the module, so this is not nav-link smuggling. Rescuing pages are real course/curriculum pages: eye/cysa 32, script/linux-essentials 26, web/network-plus 25, cloud/ms-102 24, az-104 18, pl-300 15, web/ccna 15, az-900 9, ms-900 9, aplus core-1 6, plus the CyberOps week1-5 pages that carry 7 of taskboard #239's supposed orphans. matrix/piverse (157 links, 150 to its own content) and matrix/protocore (112/102) are genuine multi-track course pages, not nav shells.
[2026-07-29 03:39] NUMBERS TRUED UP 2026-07-28 (Chris): the earlier note said 768 -> 563; the shipped figure is 544. Two corrections since: (a) the same-house constraint means 204 rescued not 205, giving 564; (b) fixing root-relative href resolution (path.join does not treat a leading slash as root, so '/houses/...' links resolved to nonsense and never matched) rescued 20 MORE genuinely-curated modules. Final: orphans 768 -> 544, mechanism5_coursePageLinks 2412. That resolution bug was LIVE, not latent -- it was silently orphaning 20 real modules.
[2026-07-31 11:05] VERIFIED RESOLVED 2026-07-31 against the shipped report (_tools/reports/STRICT_ORPHAN_MAP.json, generated 2026-07-29). mechanism5_coursePageLinks is live with 2412 rescues; the definition line now reads '...or a link from a same-house course page'. Orphans 768 -> 544. The specific defect in this ticket is gone: eye-cysa modules still reported as orphan = 0 (was 32). Caveat for whoever re-opens this: the report predates today's registry work, so re-run the scanner before quoting 544 as current.
